raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

#59824 enabled DSpark adaptive verification (AV) on `ROCM_AITER_MLA` for `decode_context_parallel_size == 1` only. Kimi-K3 on MI355X serves its mid- and high-concurrency points at TP8/DCP8, where AV was refused after the weight load. This PR enables AV at DCP > 1 on the routes that place verify queries by global position (cprr asm, segmented MLA, gfx942 Triton).

## Claims

- AV produces exact attention at DCP > 1 on the cprr and segmented routes (unit level with real kernels; see Validation).
- Every kernel input stays exactly as in uniform DCP verify: local and global lengths, `g_kv_indptr`, page indices, no `CLAMP_TAIL`. Only the q/o row maps change; unlike DCP1 there is no extra page-index buffer for padded lengths.
- An AV + DCP configuration that no route can serve now fails at backend selection, before the weights load, instead of in the AV manager after the load.
- DCP1 behaviour is unchanged.

## Validation

All runs on MI355X (gfx950), `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-e68efc685ab1`, AITER 0.1.25.

**New GPU test** (`tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_dcp_cprr_numerics.py::test_adaptive_varlen_shards_match_reference`, cprr and segmented). It runs the real `AiterMLAMetadataBuilder.build` and the real kernels, with the 8 DCP ranks simulated one after another on one GPU, as the existing cprr test does.
- **Shape:** Kimi-K3's verify shape: 96 gathered heads padded to 128, W = 5.
- **Batch:** ragged device admitted lengths behind an even host split. It includes a single token, a full block, sequences shorter than the block and than DCP, cudagraph dummy requests, and token padding past the last request.
- **Per shard:** the output and LSE must match an exact torch reference with causality on global positions.
- **Merge:** the raw shards go through the production `correct_attn_out` over `mask_dcp_empty_shards_`-masked LSEs. The merged output must be finite and must match full-context attention.

**New CPU tests** (`tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py`):
- **`test_varlen_cudagraph_bound_follows_adaptive_verification` (extended):** covers the gate with DCP8, interleave 2, W = 2 and `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_DCP_VERIFY=segmented`.
- **`test_backend_rejects_unsupported_adaptive_dcp`:** `validate_configuration` raises.
- **`test_dcp_varlen_right_aligns_rows_and_keeps_lengths`:** the right-aligned q/o row maps, the unchanged local and global lengths, and `CLAMP_TAIL` off.

**Mutation check.** Each of the following mutants fails at least one of these tests:
- right-align disabled, or a shift off by one;
- the seq-len pad re-applied at DCP, or `CLAMP_TAIL` always on;
- the LSE gather dropped (GPU test only);
- the `row_pos >= 0` term removed;
- in the gate: always passing, no interleave check, no `W >= 3` term, no `segmented` env clause;
- the `validate_configuration` hook removed.

**Regression**, this branch vs `main` (70a609ac40) on the same image:

| Suite | branch | main |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_{mtp_split,dcp_cprr,dcp_cprr_numerics,dcp_verify_gfx942,fp8_decode_routing}.py` | 577 passed, 7 skipped | 573 passed, 7 skipped |
| `tests/models/kimi_k3/test_amd_kda_adaptive_verification.py`, `tests/v1/worker/test_attn_utils.py`, `tests/kernels/attention/test_attention_selector.py` | 122 passed | 122 passed |
| `tests/v1/attention/test_mla_backends.py -k "aiter or AITER or varlen or adaptive or ragged"` (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`) | 581 passed | 581 passed |

Reproduce:
```bash
pytest tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py \
       tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_dcp_cprr.py \
       tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_dcp_cprr_numerics.py   # numerics need gfx950
```

## Details

**Why the DCP1 layout is wrong under DCP.** Under AV, the host `query_start_loc_cpu` holds an even split of the draft budget, and the device `query_start_loc` holds each request's admitted length q ≤ W = K + 1. At DCP1, #59824 runs every request as a uniform W-row block:
- Real tokens are left-aligned.
- The kernel KV length is extended by the pad `W - q`.
- The page tail is clamped.

At DCP > 1 that pad lands on the rank-local length, while cprr builds query positions from `g_kv_indptr`, which holds the unpadded global length. Real token t then sits at global position `S - W + t` instead of `S - q + t`, and loses `W - q` causal tokens, its own included.

**Right-align instead.** At DCP > 1 the admitted tokens are written into rows `W - q .. W - 1` of their block (`_fill_varlen_rows`). The routes then line up without touching any length:
- **cprr:** block row i sits at global position `G - W + i`. cprr derives a request's query positions from its `qo_indptr` width and its global length, so real token t lands on `S - q + t` exactly.
- **Segmented / Triton row view:** row t covers global positions `[0, S - W + t]`, which gives the same windows.
- **Pad rows:** they sit at earlier positions and only read pages the request already owns. `varlen_o_rows` drops their outputs.

At DCP1 right-alignment faulted the ASM kernel on contexts shorter than the block. That was because the plain kernel trims the block's causal tail against the local end, which cprr does not do. The GPU numerics cover sequences shorter than the block and than DCP.

**Empty shards.** For a request with nothing on a rank, the cprr kernel leaves the LSE unspecified (finite or NaN). As in uniform DCP verify, the combine masks those rows via `seq_lens == 0`, and `correct_attn_out` zeroes zero-weight partials. The numerics test now runs the merge through this production path.

**Fail early.** `_adaptive_dcp_verify_unsupported_reason` rejects these configurations:
- `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size != 1`;
- no route that places queries by global position: cprr needs gfx950, `W >= 3`, and the env not forced to `segmented`; otherwise segmented MLA or gfx942 Triton is required.

`AiterMLABackend.validate_configuration` raises with that reason rather than returning it. No other ROCm MLA backend supports AV under DCP. Without the raise, auto-selection falls back to `TRITON_MLA`, and that fails in the AV manager only after the weight load.

**Limitations**
- **#62769 is required.** At DCP > 1 the DCP group is the TP group. Each rank computes its own draft budget and per-request split, and the q head gather, the LSE merge and the round-robin KV writes all assume every rank uses the same split. Without consensus, a divergence is silently wrong output, not a hang. This exposure already exists for TP > 1 at DCP1 through the o_proj all-reduce; DCP adds the attention collectives to it.
- **Performance.** At DCP8 every batch still runs `num_reqs × W` attention rows, so AV saves only the MoE, GEMM, KDA and collective work on trimmed tokens. Performance data will come with the end-to-end run.
- **Not covered by tests:** FULL-graph replay of ragged splits at a fixed captured size, the gfx942 Triton row view, and W = 2 (segmented only). The GPU numerics run in the same CI step as the existing cprr numerics.

Can you also check that DCP > 1 works, as well as the old way of DCP == 1?

### PR Pundit review

(Testing PR Pundit Code Review agent. Not all comments may be relevant. This is a one-time automated pass: please address what is useful, no need to request a re-review. Reach out to @peymanr for suggestions and feedback.)

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🟠 | gfx942 Triton adaptive/varlen path has no numerical coverage | `tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_dcp_cprr_numerics.py:577` |
| 2 | 🔵 | Unsupported config raises instead of appending invalid reason | `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:617-630` |
| 3 | 🔵 | Route-capability predicate duplicated and inconsistent with builder | `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:489-513` |
| 4 | 🔵 | DCP routing comment and new helpers lack documentation | `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:378-399` |
| 5 | 🔵 | Refusal error messages are incomplete and misleading | `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:496-512,627-630` |
| 6 | 🔵 | Backend-rejection tests miss positive case and second branch | `tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py:1486-1530` |
| 7 | 🔵 | Right-align test hand-wires builder state, bypassing __init__ | `tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py:1525-1590` |
| 8 | 🔵 | Unnecessary function-local import of vllm.config | `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:618` |

#### 1. 🟠 Should fix: gfx942 Triton adaptive/varlen path has no numerical coverage
`tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_dcp_cprr_numerics.py:577`

`_adaptive_dcp_verify_unsupported_reason` enables adaptive varlen DCP verify on the gfx942 Triton route, but `test_adaptive_varlen_shards_match_reference` is gated by `requires_cprr` (gfx950) and the gfx942 test has no adaptive case. A regression in right-aligned rows or LSE selection on the Triton route would go unnoticed. Parametrize `test_dcp_verify_matches_attention` to cover it.

**Who is affected:** gfx942 (MI300/MI325) deployments running DCP>1 with cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 1 and enable_adaptive_verification, e.g. Kimi-K3 DSpark at DCP 8, whose verify batches take the TRITON route.

_Verified by running it._

#### 2. 🔵 Nit: Unsupported config raises instead of appending invalid reason
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:617-630`

`AiterMLABackend.validate_configuration` raises `ValueError` for unsupported adaptive-verification + DCP configs, unlike every other check, which uses `invalid_reasons.append(...)`. The ROCm selector catches only `ImportError`, so auto-selection stops at `ROCM_AITER_MLA` instead of recording a reason. In practice no fallback could serve this config. `ROCM_AITER_TRITON_MLA` inherits the same check. `TritonMLAMetadataBuilder` (`supports_dcp_with_varlen` defaults to False) is rejected by `_validate_dspark_dcp_support` for DSpark with DCP. So the user sees a hard error either way, and appending the reason is only for consistency and the selector's aggregated diagnostics.

**Who is affected:** ROCm MLA users running DSpark with `enable_adaptive_verification` and `decode_context_parallel_size>1` in an unsupported layout (e.g. `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size!=1`); they get this ValueError instead of a selector or builder ValueError.

_Verified by running it._

**Related past reviews:** [#55966](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55966) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`

#### 3. 🔵 Nit: Route-capability predicate duplicated and inconsistent with builder
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:489-513`

`_adaptive_dcp_verify_unsupported_reason` treats cprr as available from `_asm_dcp_verify_configured` alone and does not check `_asm_dcp_verify_heads(num_heads*dcp)`. So on gfx950 with more than 128 DCP-gathered heads and no segmented MLA, it accepts the config. `AiterMLAMetadataBuilder.__init__` then rejects it at startup with an explicit `ValueError` naming the head count, which the builder already raised before this PR. Leaving out `_segmented_mla_fits_lds` has no effect, because on gfx942 the Triton verify always covers shapes that do not fit. Sharing one predicate would only move the error into validation.

**Who is affected:** Only gfx950 DCP deployments with more than 128 gathered heads whose AITER build lacks segmented MLA; they get the builder's specific startup error instead of the validation error.

**Related past reviews:** [#56861](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56861) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`

#### 4. 🔵 Nit: DCP routing comment and new helpers lack documentation
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:378-399`

Under DCP, adaptive varlen verify right-aligns rows: `_fill_varlen_rows` shifts `row_pos` by `width - row_qlen`, `seq_lens_for_kernel` is not inflated, and `CLAMP_TAIL` is off. With DCP=1 it left-aligns with inflated seq lens, `CLAMP_TAIL`, and extra `max_num_pages` slack. Skipping the extra page reservation under DCP is correct, because nothing is inflated, but no comment says so. `_varlen_right_align` has no docstring, and the 'DCP decode routing' block does not mention adaptive varlen verify. Add a short note that CPRR and the row-view routes take positions from global lengths (`g_kv_indptr` / `dcp_tot_seq_lens`) and so cannot absorb left-pad inflation.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers reading `rocm_aiter_mla.py`; there is no runtime effect.

**Related past reviews:** [#56861](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56861) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`, [#51705](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51705) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`, [#51171](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51171) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`

#### 5. 🔵 Nit: Refusal error messages are incomplete and misleading
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:496-512,627-630`

The generic refusal from `_adaptive_dcp_verify_unsupported_reason` ("needs the round-robin asm decode, segmented MLA or the gfx942 Triton verify") does not say what the asm route needs. It needs gfx950 and `max_decode_query_len >= _MIN_CPRR_QLEN` (3), i.e. `num_speculative_tokens >= 2`. So on gfx950 without segmented MLA and with `num_speculative_tokens=1`, the user is not told that more speculative tokens would fix it. Consider naming the gfx950 / `num_speculative_tokens >= 2` requirement in the message.

**Who is affected:** gfx950 users enabling adaptive verification with DCP, `num_speculative_tokens=1` and an AITER build without segmented MLA, who get a less actionable startup error.

_Verified by running it._

**Related past reviews:** [#56861](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56861) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`, [#42294](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42294) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`

#### 6. 🔵 Nit: Backend-rejection tests miss positive case and second branch
`tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py:1486-1530`

`test_backend_rejects_unsupported_adaptive_dcp` only exercises the `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size != 1` rejection. It never asserts the return of `validate(use_dcp=True)` and has no positive case (dcp=8, interleave=1, adaptive) passing through `validate_configuration`. The no-route reason is reached indirectly: the bound test's `num_speculative_tokens=1` case yields `None` through it. Its `ValueError` message is never asserted via the backend. `test_varlen_cudagraph_bound_follows_adaptive_verification` only covers the asm route; consider segmented-only and Triton-only cases.

**Who is affected:** Test coverage only; no runtime impact on ROCm AITER MLA users.

_Verified by running it._

#### 7. 🔵 Nit: Right-align test hand-wires builder state, bypassing __init__
`tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py:1525-1590`

`test_dcp_varlen_right_aligns_rows_and_keeps_lengths` hand-wires private builder state instead of calling `__init__`. It rebinds the `_varlen_right_align` property, sets the `_varlen_row_*` buffers by hand and binds `_fill_varlen_rows`. So on CPU-only runs nothing checks that the real `__init__` enables varlen with DCP>1 and skips the `max_num_pages` extension when rows are right-aligned. That path is covered only by the gfx950-gated `test_adaptive_varlen_shards_match_reference`, which builds `AiterMLAMetadataBuilder` through `__init__`. The deliberate host/device `query_start_loc` mismatch (simulating adaptive trimming) would also benefit from a comment.

**Who is affected:** Test coverage only: CI runs without a gfx950 GPU never exercise the new `__init__` buffer sizing for DCP adaptive verification.

**Related past reviews:** [#45229](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/45229) on `tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py`

#### 8. 🔵 Nit: Unnecessary function-local import of vllm.config
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:618`

The function-local `from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config_or_none` inside `validate_configuration` is unneeded since `vllm.config` is already imported at module top (line 15). Move it to the top-level imports.

**Who is affected:** Code readers only; there is no runtime effect.

**Related past reviews:** [#38947](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/38947) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`

**Right-align instead.** At DCP > 1 the admitted tokens are written into rows `W - q .. W - 1` of their block (`_fill_varlen_rows`). The routes then line up without touching any length:
- **cprr:** block row i sits at global position `G - W + i`. cprr derives a request's query positions from its `qo_indptr` width and its global length, so real token t lands on `S - q + t` exactly.
- **Segmented / Triton row view:** row t covers global positions `[0, S - W + t]`, which gives the same windows.
- **Pad rows:** they sit at earlier positions and only read pages the request already owns. `varlen_o_rows` drops their outputs.

At DCP1 right-alignment faulted the ASM kernel on contexts shorter than the block. That was because the plain kernel trims the block's causal tail against the local end, which cprr does not do. The GPU numerics cover sequences shorter than the block and than DCP.

**Empty shards.** For a request with nothing on a rank, the cprr kernel leaves the LSE unspecified (finite or NaN). As in uniform DCP verify, the combine masks those rows via `seq_lens == 0`, and `correct_attn_out` zeroes zero-weight partials. The numerics test now runs the merge through this production path.

**Fail early.** `_adaptive_dcp_verify_unsupported_reason` rejects these configurations:
- `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size != 1`;
- no route that places queries by global position: cprr needs gfx950, `W >= 3`, and the env not forced to `segmented`; otherwise segmented MLA or gfx942 Triton is required.

`AiterMLABackend.validate_configuration` raises with that reason rather than returning it. No other ROCm MLA backend supports AV under DCP. Without the raise, auto-selection falls back to `TRITON_MLA`, and that fails in the AV manager only after the weight load.

**Limitations**
- **#62769 is required.** At DCP > 1 the DCP group is the TP group. Each rank computes its own draft budget and per-request split, and the q head gather, the LSE merge and the round-robin KV writes all assume every rank uses the same split. Without consensus, a divergence is silently wrong output, not a hang. This exposure already exists for TP > 1 at DCP1 through the o_proj all-reduce; DCP adds the attention collectives to it.
- **Performance.** At DCP8 every batch still runs `num_reqs × W` attention rows, so AV saves only the MoE, GEMM, KDA and collective work on trimmed tokens. Performance data will come with the end-to-end run.
- **Not covered by tests:** FULL-graph replay of ragged splits at a fixed captured size, the gfx942 Triton row view, and W = 2 (segmented only). The GPU numerics run in the same CI step as the existing cprr numerics.

+def _varlen_reference(q_f32, kv_f32, seq_lens, qo_lens, positions_per_req):
+    heads = q_f32.shape[1]
+    o = torch.zeros(sum(qo_lens), heads, KV_LORA_RANK, device=q_f32.device)
+    lse = torch.full((sum(qo_lens), heads), float("-inf"), device=q_f32.device)
+    token = 0
+    for req, (seq_len, qo_len) in enumerate(zip(seq_lens, qo_lens)):
+        positions = positions_per_req[req]
+        kv_sel = kv_f32[req].index_select(0, positions)
+        for t in range(qo_len):
+            valid = positions <= seq_len - qo_len + t
+            if bool(valid.any()):
+                k = kv_sel[valid]
+                s = (q_f32[token] @ k.T) * SCALE
+                lse[token] = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=-1)
+                o[token] = torch.softmax(s, dim=-1) @ k[:, :KV_LORA_RANK]
+            token += 1
+    return o, lse
+

### PR Pundit review

(Testing PR Pundit Code Review agent. Not all comments may be relevant. This is a one-time automated pass: please address what is useful, no need to request a re-review. Reach out to @peymanr for suggestions and feedback.)

#### 1. 🟠 Should fix: gfx942 Triton adaptive/varlen path has no numerical coverage
`tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_dcp_cprr_numerics.py:577`

`_adaptive_dcp_verify_unsupported_reason` enables adaptive varlen DCP verify on the gfx942 Triton route, but `test_adaptive_varlen_shards_match_reference` is gated by `requires_cprr` (gfx950) and the gfx942 test has no adaptive case. A regression in right-aligned rows or LSE selection on the Triton route would go unnoticed. Parametrize `test_dcp_verify_matches_attention` to cover it.

**Who is affected:** gfx942 (MI300/MI325) deployments running DCP>1 with cp_kv_cache_interleave_size 1 and enable_adaptive_verification, e.g. Kimi-K3 DSpark at DCP 8, whose verify batches take the TRITON route.

_Verified by running it._

#### 2. 🔵 Nit: Unsupported config raises instead of appending invalid reason
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:617-630`

`AiterMLABackend.validate_configuration` raises `ValueError` for unsupported adaptive-verification + DCP configs, unlike every other check, which uses `invalid_reasons.append(...)`. The ROCm selector catches only `ImportError`, so auto-selection stops at `ROCM_AITER_MLA` instead of recording a reason. In practice no fallback could serve this config. `ROCM_AITER_TRITON_MLA` inherits the same check. `TritonMLAMetadataBuilder` (`supports_dcp_with_varlen` defaults to False) is rejected by `_validate_dspark_dcp_support` for DSpark with DCP. So the user sees a hard error either way, and appending the reason is only for consistency and the selector's aggregated diagnostics.

**Who is affected:** ROCm MLA users running DSpark with `enable_adaptive_verification` and `decode_context_parallel_size>1` in an unsupported layout (e.g. `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size!=1`); they get this ValueError instead of a selector or builder ValueError.

_Verified by running it._

**Related past reviews:** [#55966](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55966) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`

#### 3. 🔵 Nit: Route-capability predicate duplicated and inconsistent with builder
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:489-513`

`_adaptive_dcp_verify_unsupported_reason` treats cprr as available from `_asm_dcp_verify_configured` alone and does not check `_asm_dcp_verify_heads(num_heads*dcp)`. So on gfx950 with more than 128 DCP-gathered heads and no segmented MLA, it accepts the config. `AiterMLAMetadataBuilder.__init__` then rejects it at startup with an explicit `ValueError` naming the head count, which the builder already raised before this PR. Leaving out `_segmented_mla_fits_lds` has no effect, because on gfx942 the Triton verify always covers shapes that do not fit. Sharing one predicate would only move the error into validation.

**Who is affected:** Only gfx950 DCP deployments with more than 128 gathered heads whose AITER build lacks segmented MLA; they get the builder's specific startup error instead of the validation error.

**Related past reviews:** [#56861](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56861) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`

#### 4. 🔵 Nit: DCP routing comment and new helpers lack documentation
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:378-399`

Under DCP, adaptive varlen verify right-aligns rows: `_fill_varlen_rows` shifts `row_pos` by `width - row_qlen`, `seq_lens_for_kernel` is not inflated, and `CLAMP_TAIL` is off. With DCP=1 it left-aligns with inflated seq lens, `CLAMP_TAIL`, and extra `max_num_pages` slack. Skipping the extra page reservation under DCP is correct, because nothing is inflated, but no comment says so. `_varlen_right_align` has no docstring, and the 'DCP decode routing' block does not mention adaptive varlen verify. Add a short note that CPRR and the row-view routes take positions from global lengths (`g_kv_indptr` / `dcp_tot_seq_lens`) and so cannot absorb left-pad inflation.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers reading `rocm_aiter_mla.py`; there is no runtime effect.

**Related past reviews:** [#56861](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56861) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`, [#51705](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51705) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`, [#51171](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51171) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`

#### 5. 🔵 Nit: Refusal error messages are incomplete and misleading
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:496-512,627-630`

The generic refusal from `_adaptive_dcp_verify_unsupported_reason` ("needs the round-robin asm decode, segmented MLA or the gfx942 Triton verify") does not say what the asm route needs. It needs gfx950 and `max_decode_query_len >= _MIN_CPRR_QLEN` (3), i.e. `num_speculative_tokens >= 2`. So on gfx950 without segmented MLA and with `num_speculative_tokens=1`, the user is not told that more speculative tokens would fix it. Consider naming the gfx950 / `num_speculative_tokens >= 2` requirement in the message.

**Who is affected:** gfx950 users enabling adaptive verification with DCP, `num_speculative_tokens=1` and an AITER build without segmented MLA, who get a less actionable startup error.

_Verified by running it._

**Related past reviews:** [#56861](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/56861) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`, [#42294](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42294) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`

#### 6. 🔵 Nit: Backend-rejection tests miss positive case and second branch
`tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py:1486-1530`

`test_backend_rejects_unsupported_adaptive_dcp` only exercises the `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size != 1` rejection. It never asserts the return of `validate(use_dcp=True)` and has no positive case (dcp=8, interleave=1, adaptive) passing through `validate_configuration`. The no-route reason is reached indirectly: the bound test's `num_speculative_tokens=1` case yields `None` through it. Its `ValueError` message is never asserted via the backend. `test_varlen_cudagraph_bound_follows_adaptive_verification` only covers the asm route; consider segmented-only and Triton-only cases.

**Who is affected:** Test coverage only; no runtime impact on ROCm AITER MLA users.

_Verified by running it._

#### 7. 🔵 Nit: Right-align test hand-wires builder state, bypassing __init__
`tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py:1525-1590`

`test_dcp_varlen_right_aligns_rows_and_keeps_lengths` hand-wires private builder state instead of calling `__init__`. It rebinds the `_varlen_right_align` property, sets the `_varlen_row_*` buffers by hand and binds `_fill_varlen_rows`. So on CPU-only runs nothing checks that the real `__init__` enables varlen with DCP>1 and skips the `max_num_pages` extension when rows are right-aligned. That path is covered only by the gfx950-gated `test_adaptive_varlen_shards_match_reference`, which builds `AiterMLAMetadataBuilder` through `__init__`. The deliberate host/device `query_start_loc` mismatch (simulating adaptive trimming) would also benefit from a comment.

**Who is affected:** Test coverage only: CI runs without a gfx950 GPU never exercise the new `__init__` buffer sizing for DCP adaptive verification.

**Related past reviews:** [#45229](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/45229) on `tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_mtp_split.py`

#### 8. 🔵 Nit: Unnecessary function-local import of vllm.config
`vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py:618`

The function-local `from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config_or_none` inside `validate_configuration` is unneeded since `vllm.config` is already imported at module top (line 15). Move it to the top-level imports.

**Who is affected:** Code readers only; there is no runtime effect.

**Related past reviews:** [#38947](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/38947) on `vllm/v1/attention/backends/mla/rocm_aiter_mla.py`
